question: Shellfish farming is highly dependent on water quality. The Water Framework Directive (WFD) provides for the establishment of a register of protected areas (Article 6) encompassing all areas covered by Annex IV, including areas designated for the protection of aquatic species of economic importance.

The guidance note on the application of the Water Framework Directive and the Marine Strategy Framework Directive to aquaculture1 states that Member States are required to ensure, through the correct implementation of the WFD, at least the same level of protection against pollution of shellfish waters as is provided for under the Shellfish Waters Directive2.
River basin management plans must include shellfish waters as protected areas. 1.
Will the Commission take the opportunity of its next WFD implementation report to specifically analyse the measures taken by Member States in relation to the protection of shellfish waters?
Has the Commission identified good practices in the protection of shellfish waters in Member States?

Commission Staff Working Document on the application of the Water Framework Directive and the Marine Strategy Framework Directive to aquaculture. Council Directive 79/923/EEC of 30 October 1979 on the quality required of shellfish waters, repealed by the WFD.
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (20.6.2024) The Commission is in the process of assessing the Third River Basin Management Plans under the Water Framework Directive1 and will publish its report before the end of 2024. The assessment will analyse the programmes of measures put in place by Member States to achieve good status of waters in general.

More specifically, the assessment will also look at whether Member States have established protected areas for economically significant species, including shellfish, and whether additional objectives and corresponding measures have been set for such areas. Thus, the Commission is not yet in the position to comment on the measures set by the Member States for the protection of shellfish waters.

The Commission is currently developing a Guidance document on environmental performance of aquaculture, as part of the implementation of the ‘Strategic guidelines for a more sustainable and competitive EU aquaculture for the period 2021 to 2030’2, which will also seek to identify and present good practices in the protection of shellfish waters in Member States.
1 Directive 2000/60/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 October 2000 establishing a

framework for Community action in the field of water policy, OJ L 327, 22.12.2000, p. 1–73, as amended by Commission Directive 2014/101/EU of 30 October 2014, OJ L 311, 31.10.2014, p. 32–35. 2 https://ec.europa.eu/commission/presscorner/detail/en/ip_21_1554
